title: A Child's Bond
description: Giamum Yame and her two-year-old son live in the small village of Pochung in Arunachal Pradesh State, India. The village's population is 73, according to census data from 2011. Arunachal Pradesh State, which translates to "Land of the Rising Sun," contains many distinct ethnic groups, and the region has been part of a sovereignty dispute between India and China since 1914.
translated_description: 吉亚姆·亚梅和她两岁的儿子住在印度阿鲁纳恰尔邦的波琼小村庄。根据2011年的人口普查数据，该村共有73人。阿鲁纳恰尔邦意为“旭日之地”，这里聚居着众多独特的民族群体。自1914年以来，该地区一直是印度与中国主权争议的一部分。
